_how_to_edit: Add a new trip at the top of the list. 'image' can be a path to a photo in the images/ folder (e.g. images/uk-2026.jpg) or left empty. Remove 'example': true from real posts. If Instagram is connected (behold_feed_url in config.json), Instagram posts show here automatically and this list is used as a fallback.

posts.title: Barsi samagam at Dera Sant Ghar
posts.text: Akhand Paath, kirtan and katha in remembrance of Sant Baba Jawala Singh Ji, with sangat from across Doaba.

posts.title: Katha divans with UK sangat
posts.text: A week of evening divans on Sukhmani Sahib, with Amrit Sanchar held on the final Sunday.

posts.title: Hola Mohalla darshan
posts.text: Babaji joined the sangat at Takht Sri Kesgarh Sahib and spoke on the founding of the Khalsa and the Panj Pyare.
